content_sections.heading: Pondicherry University Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Pondicherry University, Karaikal Campus (a Central University)
Guest Faculty (Health and Wellness), purely temporary
Honorarium of Rs. 1500 per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month
Until regular faculty is appointed or the end of Academic Year 2026-27, whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: About Pondicherry University
content_sections.text: Pondicherry University is a Central University. The notice is issued by its Karaikal Campus, Karaikal – 609 605, Puducherry UT, over the signature of Dr. K. Tharanikkarasu, Professor and Centre Head. The campus telephone number printed in the notice is 04368-231029.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice says reservation will be followed as per GoI. If a suitable EWS candidate is not available, the Selection committee may select any one candidate, irrespective of category or reservation, as the Resource person on the same honorarium of Rs. 1500 per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The required specialization printed in the notice is Physical Education and Sports, or Physical Education, or Sports Science, or Yoga (physical education + yoga). Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification: Master's Degree with 55% marks in Physical Education and Sports or Physical Education or Sports Science or Master's degree level Yoga; and UGC-NET, or Ph.D. Degree in Physical Education or Physical Education and Sports or Sports Science or Yoga, as per UGC Minimum Standards and Procedure of the Regulations, 2009 or 2016
rows.experience: Preference will be given to candidates with experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Honorarium: Rs. 1500 per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month. The appointment is purely temporary and is not a permanent position. The engagement continues until the appointment of regular faculty or until the end of Academic Year 2026-27, whichever is earlier. Selected candidates may be required to join duties immediately, to teach NEP-UG courses. The candidate should not be in receipt of any other scholarship, fellowship or salary during the guest faculty period. Full-time Ph.D. scholars are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Pondicherry University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates must apply by email to [email protected] on or before 5:00 p.m. on 30 November 2026. The notice states that the first paragraph advises applying to [email protected] ; the later instruction, which names the documents and the 5:00 p.m. deadline, gives [email protected] . Prepare scanned copies of the documents listed below. Email them to [email protected] before 5:00 p.m. on 30 November 2026. State in the application the category (GEN/OBC/SC/ST/EWS) for which you are applying. OBC and EWS candidates must include a latest caste/income certificate issued by the competent authority on or after April 2026; only those will be considered. Eligible candidates will be called for an interview online. The online interview details will be communicated in advance only to the eligible short-listed candidates. The tentative date and time of the interview will be intimated to the eligible candidates. All original certificates, testimonials and a copy of the Bio-Data will be verified before the offer is issued to a selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Scanned copies of all original certificates of educational qualifications: 10th, +2, UG, PG, Ph.D Latest community certificate for OBC/EWS candidates, wherever applicable Publications, if any Testimonials A recent passport-size photo A signed copy of the up-to-date Curriculum Vitae (CV)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: A CV submitted without document proof will not be considered for scrutiny for the online interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The selection is purely temporary and not a permanent position. OBC and EWS candidates whose certificate is not issued on or after April 2026 will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Faculty posts are vacant at Pondicherry University Karaikal Campus?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Guest Faculty in Health and Wellness, reserved for EWS, on a purely temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 5:00 p.m. on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree with 55% marks in Physical Education and Sports, Physical Education, Sports Science or Master's degree level Yoga, and UGC-NET or a Ph.D. in Physical Education, Physical Education and Sports, Sports Science or Yoga as per UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for the Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Rs. 1500 per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email scanned copies of your documents to [email protected] before 5:00 p.m. on 30 November 2026, mentioning your category (GEN/OBC/SC/ST/EWS).

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are called for an online interview, after the documents sent are scrutinised. Original certificates, testimonials and the Bio-Data are verified before the offer is issued.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and continues until regular faculty is appointed or the end of Academic Year 2026-27, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who is not eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Full-time Ph.D. scholars are not eligible, and the candidate should not be in receipt of any other scholarship, fellowship or salary during the guest faculty period.

faq.question: Q10. Which certificate must OBC and EWS candidates submit?
faq.answer: They must submit the latest caste/income certificate issued by the competent authority on or after April 2026; only those will be considered.
